description: List open incidents ranked by SLA breach risk. Computes a risk level for each incident based on due_at and sla_violations: "breached" (overdue or has violations), "critical" (due within 4 hours), "warning" (due within at_risk_within_hours), "ok", or "no_due_date". Results are sorted with breached first (most overdue first), then by time-to-breach ascending, no_due_date last. Defaults to excluding Resolved and Closed states. Limitation: incident list rows only normally include due_at. The sla_violations[] array is only present on the long incident layout, so rows are ranked primarily by due_at and violations are counted only when SWSD happens to include them on the row. Use swsd_get_incident with detail_level long for a complete per-incident SLA picture.

assigned_to_group.description: Filter to incidents assigned to this group ID (server-side).

assignee_email.description: Client-side case-insensitive filter on assignee email (SWSD ignores it server-side).

at_risk_within_hours.description: Hours threshold for "warning" risk bucket. Default 24, max 720 (30 days).

include_no_due_date.description: Include incidents with no due_at in results. Default false.

max_results.description: Cap returned incidents while scanning up to 10 pages from page (also bounded by page 10000). Stops when enough matches are found; ranks the scanned matches only. scan.truncated reports omitted matches or remaining pages. Without this option, scans one page.

per_page.description: Results per page (1-100). SWSD caps at 100.

priorities.description: Filter to incidents matching ANY of these priorities.

state_is_not.description: Negative state filter. Defaults to excluding Resolved and Closed.

states.description: Filter to incidents matching ANY of these states.

updated_from.description: Filter to incidents updated on or after this ISO date or datetime.

updated_within.description: Convenience alias for updated_from: "Nh" is an exact hours-ago ISO timestamp; "Nd" and "Nw" use the UTC calendar date N days or N weeks ago. N must be 1-365. Ignored if updated_from is explicitly set.

name: swsd_sla_risk

counts.description: Count of incidents per risk level.

now.description: ISO timestamp used as the reference clock for risk computation.

has_more.description: True when more pages exist beyond this one.

matched_total.description: Total matching records, or null when unknown. After local filtering, known only when all candidate pages were scanned from page 1. Independent of display caps.

next_page.description: The next page number to request, when has_more is true.

per_page.description: Items per page used in the request.

total.description: Total record count when SWSD returns X-Total-Count.

total_scope.description: Scope of the upstream `total`: 'upstream' = candidates before local filtering; 'filtered' = server-filtered count with no local filtering; 'tenant' = unfiltered count; 'unknown' = total absent. Sorting and display options are not filters.

truncated.description: True when candidate pages remain or max_results omitted scanned matches.
